title: Noitemburn
description: NoItemBurn is a Minecraft plugin that prevents items from burning in fire or lava, featuring a command-based system to toggle this protection per world.
body:
NoItemBurn is a Minecraft plugin that prevents items from burning in fire or lava, featuring a command-based system to toggle this protection per world. Built on Java 21, it ensures compatibility across Minecraft versions 1.19.4 through 1.21+

To add a world:

```
/noitemburn worldadd <name>
```

To remove a world:
```
/noitemburn worldremove <name>
```

Suggestions are open in the [discord](https://discord.gg/tabjev2y4x)
